sections.heading: 1939 Market - Special Inspections Consultant
paragraphs: The Project Team requests proposals from qualified firms interested in providing special inspections consultant services for the design and construction of 1939 Market, a 15-story multi-family residential building, with a total of 187 affordable apartments for seniors (a mix of studio and one-bedroom units with one two-bedroom manager unit). The building’s ground floor includes a 1,483 square foot commercial space, which will be utilized as an extension of the robust services program. 1939 Market will be developed by Mercy Housing California, and will be owned by Mercy Housing California 109, L.P. The selected professional services consultants will contract directly with Mercy Housing California 109, L.P.
Contact: Emma Wynkoop and Sean Wils Phone: 415-355-7165 and 415-355-7152 Email Emma.wynkoop@mercyhousing.org Sean.Wils@mercyhousing.org

sections.heading: 2901-2929 16th St - Electrical
paragraphs: Project Description : This bid advertisement is only for Electrical and Joint Trench scopes only. The scope of work for electrical and joint trench includes trenching from an exterior PG&E box in the public right of way to a new underground vault location on the public sidewalk, and trenching into the property at 2901 16th St for a new main electrical room. Electrical scope of work includes underground installations within the joint trench for a 2,000A service to a new electrical room, installing new subpanels and feeders for 63 residential units. The 63 new residential subpanels and 8 existing commercial subpanels will have new feeders going to the new electrical room on the ground floor. Please refer to attached bid documents and drawing for detailed scope of work.
Contact: AmOne Office Phone: 415.826.9678 Email estimates@amonecorp.com

sections.heading: Laguna Honda Senior Housing - Early DB Trades Bid
paragraphs: Project Description : THIS IS A CAHILL/GUZMAN JOINT VENTURE. New construction of a 159-unit Senior Housing building. Project will also include Health Services, Senior Center, Home Health Services and Early Childcare Education Center. Development is located on the site of and adjacent to the Laguna Honda Hospital in San Francisco. (This project used to be 2 phases/buildings and now is planned to be a single building.)
